_comment: Publication dates for cited pages whose citation carries none, found on 24 September 2026. method: meta (the page's own date metadata), visible (a date printed as the publication date), url (a date in the URL path), document (a PDF's date or a file's first commit). First-archived dates and registry field dates were not accepted: the first is only an upper bound and the second is not a publication date. src/_data/sources.js and scripts/ingest-scraped-iocs.js read this, and a date here wins over one on the citation, because a scraped citation's date is whatever the extractor last read. A second pass on 4 October 2026 dated the remaining citations behind the Report date column of the indicator search; a citation of an account or repository page, a registry profile or a LinkedIn profile has no publication date and was left without one. For this site's own candidate pages, the date is the row's first_seen in candidates.json.
